description: This file contains utility methods for evaluating and handling Groovy scripts within the OFBiz framework, including script parsing, dynamic evaluation, and script class loading.

classes.name: GroovyUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for evaluating Groovy expressions, loading Groovy scripts, parsing classes, and executing scripts within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a Groovy expression with a given context and returns the result.

methods.name: getBinding
methods.description: Creates a Groovy Binding object initialized with variables from the given context and expression.

methods.name: getScriptClassFromLocation
methods.description: Loads and parses a Groovy script class from a specified location, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a Groovy class from an InputStream.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a Groovy class from a text string.

methods.name: runScriptAtLocation
methods.description: Runs a Groovy script located at a specific path, optionally invoking a method within that script, with a given execution context.
